# Tottenham under De Zerbi: what the numbers say (2026-27)

*Data cut-off: 2026-10-19 23:06 UTC. Premier League matches only (7). Figures from the Fantasy Premier League API (Opta-derived xG/xA). Analysis is calculated by rule from those figures and is not official.*

## Headline numbers

| | Value |
|---|---|
| Record (W-D-L) | 1-3-3 |
| Goals for / against | 6 / 10 |
| xG for / against (est.) | 7.50 / 9.40 |
| Clean sheets | 2 |

## Coach comparison

| Coach | PL matches | Pts/game | xG/game | xGA/game |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Roberto De Zerbi | 7 | 0.86 | 1.07 | 1.34 |

*Earlier coaches cover stored seasons only; xG available from 2022-23.*

## Findings

**Scoring below chance quality.** Spurs have scored 6 Premier League goals from 7.50 xG (-1.50). *Interpretation: Finishing is underperforming the chances; if chance quality holds, goals would be expected to rise.* _(Sample: 7 PL matches with xG.)_

**Conceding more than chances faced suggest.** Spurs have conceded 10 from an estimated 9.40 xG against (+0.60). *Interpretation: Goals conceded are close to the quality of chances allowed.* _(Sample: 7 PL matches.)_

**Last five matches vs season average.** Last 5: 1.16 xG and 0.96 xG against per match, compared with 1.07 and 1.34 across the season. *Interpretation: Underlying performance (xG difference) has improved recently.* _(Sample: 5 vs 7 matches.)_

**Points per game by venue.** 1.00 points per game at home (4 matches) and 0.67 away (3). _(Sample: 7 PL matches.)_

**Creation is spread across the squad.** Tonali accounts for 21% of the squad's 5.78 expected assists. _(Sample: 7 PL matches.)_

**Chance quality versus the league.** Spurs rank 18th of 20 for xG created per match (1.07) and 5th for estimated xG conceded per 90 (1.34). _(Sample: 7 PL matches each.)_

**11 players flagged.** Marmoush: Doubtful — Calf injury - 75% chance of playing; Robertson: Doubtful — Foot injury - 75% chance of playing; Bentancur: Suspended — Suspended until 7 Nov; Sávio: Injured — Muscular injury - Expected back 7 Nov; Pedro Porro: Injured — Hamstring injury - Expected back 24 Oct; Udogie: Doubtful — Knee injury - 75% chance of playing; Bergvall: Injured — Knee injury - Expected back 31 Oct; Tosin: Doubtful — Calf injury - 75% chance of playing; Mudryk: Injured — Ankle injury - Unknown return date; Xavi: Injured — Knee injury - Unknown return date; Odobert: Injured — Knee injury - Unknown return date _(Sample: Latest FPL availability flags.)_

## What this data cannot show

Build-up structure, pressing, rotations, set-piece routines and formations need event or tracking data that is not freely available, so they are not assessed here.

## Sources

- FPL Core Insights — github.com/olbauday/FPL-Elo-Insights (shots, passing, take-ons, possession; match data collected from FotMob)
- Fantasy Premier League API — fantasy.premierleague.com/api (fixtures, results, player statistics; Opta-derived xG/xA)
- TheSportsDB — thesportsdb.com (non-Premier League fixtures and score cross-check)
- YouTube — official Tottenham Hotspur and Premier League channels plus Sky Sports Premier League, The Athletic FC, Coaches' Voice, HITC Sevens, The Overlap and Last Word On Spurs (video metadata and links only)
